title: Strategic Customer Development Manager
description:
Description

Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic Strategic Customer Development (SCD) Manager, based in Brazil, to drive customer engagement and business development for Biologics and Microbiology across key LATAM markets: Brazil (50%), Mexico (30%), Argentina (20%), and Colombia (10%). This leadership role is ideal for a professional passionate about innovation in the life sciences sector and skilled in cultivating high-impact relationships.

As a core member of the LATAM team, the SCD Manager will take ownership of customer and stakeholder engagement, overseeing a portfolio of approximately 30 strategic accounts in the Biologics segment. This includes identifying and expanding opportunities with both established and emerging biopharmaceutical companies, reinforcing USP’s presence and value proposition in the region. Working in close partnership with the Marketing Director, LATAM Senior Director, and cross-functional teams such as Regional Program Operations (Bios PUT), the incumbent will co-develop and execute account plans aligned with global initiatives, driving measurable outcomes that contribute to LATAM’s strategic goals.

Collaboration will be key, this role will actively interface with Scientific Affairs and External Affairs to align on customer needs, market trends, and advocacy opportunities, amplifying USP’s impact through targeted promotion of its products and services.

This is a unique opportunity for a people-centric leader with a regional mindset and a passion for advancing public health through strategic partnerships and innovation in Biologics.

How will YOU create impact here at USP?

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Strategic Customer Development Manager has the following responsibilities:

• This position highly impact USP mission and current Global strategies/key resolution, by visiting and supporting Biologics customers, and by identifying new key people and decision-makers in Biologics market in LATAM, promoting USP’s products and services to support the improvement of quality of medicines.

• This person will impact USP sustainability by developing and implementing engagement strategies to grow USP RS Bios sales and to expand relationships with its target-audience. Likewise, they will create high-valued relationships to increase USP’s account penetration and the overall value of USP within each account and stakeholders.

• Works closely with Biologics Global team by understanding Bios strategies and activities to be adequately implemented in LATAM market. Also, they will actively participate as a champion in Bios Global regional team to represent LATAM.

• Works with LATAM Marketing & LATAM Sr. Director, other LATAM team members in analyzing data, preparing reports on Biologics revenue trends for USP and competitor products, and make recommendations on business impact and directions.

• Develop an overall understanding of USP’s business in its targeted market (Bios). Understands the macro and micro factors that influence USP’s overall business to factors relevant to specific users (of USP products and/or services) within manufacturer organizations.

• Work in collaboration and supporting GEA team to provide training/Bios workshops to Regulators and stakeholders.

• Acquires knowledge on how the customers use USP products and identify areas for potential new business.

• Analyzes sales data for domestic and regional accounts and identifies trends and patterns that can assist the RPO staff in developing strategic plans for future revenue growth.

• Participates in User Forums, face-to-face and/or virtual customer visits and USP trade shows to educate customers and to promote USP reference standards, publications, and education products.

Who is USP Looking For?

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, biotechnology, or chemistry.

• Sales and account management experience in the Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical and/or Biopharma Lab Services industries.

• Strong account and project management skills required.

• Flexibility to travel to other countries, such as Mexico, Argentina and Colombia.

• Excellent interpersonal and communications skills.

• Self-motivated and proactive with sense of urgency, ability to prioritize and focus on key objectives and able to work in a fast-paced multi-task environment.

• Proven aptitude for building relationships, credibility, and trust with customers, and creating a collaborative work environment.

• Ability to influence without direct authority.

• Solution-oriented and innovative; can identify creative options for resolving issues that respond to multiple customer interests and needs.

• Native Portuguese; Proficiency in Spanish and English.

Additional Desired Preferences

• Excellent knowledge and understanding of pharma industries with established contacts within the research, lab management and product development departments.

• Scientific background and understanding coupled with successful sales track record are strongly preferred.

• Experience in an analytical laboratory desired.

• Experience delivering oral presentations to groups of people desired.

• Proven ability to convert prospects into customers and build long term relationships.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None, this is an individual contributor role.

Benefits

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

Title: Application Modernization Specialist

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Company Description:

Mechanized AI is at the forefront of AI innovation, leveraging cutting-edge technology to transform legacy systems into modern, efficient, and scalable solutions. We work with enterprise clients to breathe life into their existing software, ensuring that they can meet the demands of today’s fast-paced, digital landscape. Our team thrives on solving complex challenges and delivering innovative solutions. As an organization, we are committed to fostering an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Application Modernization Specialist to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate will have a background in software architecture and extensive experience leading modernization projects. While expertise in migrating from COBOL to newer programming languages is highly desirable, we are also open to candidates with a track record of successfully transforming other legacy systems into modern technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute software modernization projects, ensuring the seamless transition from legacy systems to modern, scalable architectures
  • Analyze existing legacy codebases to understand business logic, dependencies, and potential risks during migration
  • Design and implement solutions that maintain the integrity and functionality of legacy systems while improving performance, scalability, and maintainability
  • Engage with clients throughout the project lifecycle to gather requirements, communicate progress, and ensure deliverables meet their business goals and expectations
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, business analysts, and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the modernization process
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with legacy system migrations, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations
  • Document architectural designs, migration strategies, and other technical details to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in software modernization to continuously improve our methodologies and tools

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or related field
  • Experience as a Software Architect or Senior Developer focused on modernization projects
  • Client delivery experience
  • Expertise migrating legacy systems (preferably from COBOL) to modern languages such as Java, C#, Python, or similar
  • Deep understanding of software architecture principles, design patterns, and best practices
  • Experience with tools and methodologies for code analysis, refactoring, and automated testing
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to propose innovative solutions and troubleshoot issues
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment
  • Effective written and oral communications skills – C1/C2 (advanced/proficient) level English is required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) in the context of modernization projects
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams of 5+ developers, including mentoring, code reviews, and technical direction

Join to apply for the Alliances Field Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Backend Rust Engineer
Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
Mission Statement
We are seeking a Rust or C++ Engineer with trading experience to join our Options High-Frequency Trading (HFT) team . Our technology stack is built on Rust, Node.js, and Python , and while Rust proficiency is preferred, we welcome strong C++/C engineers who are eager to learn and master Rust .
As part of the Options HFT engineering team , you will drive continuous improvements in trading infrastructure and system performance. You will join a small but rapidly growing business unit within Keyrock, where you will be able to make a big impact on the bottom line while collaborating in a global fully remote team. This role is open to candidates located in European or US time zones .
What You'll Do

  • Develop and optimise low-latency options trading systems
  • Collaborate with quants, traders, and engineers to enhance trading strategies
  • Maintain and improve trading infrastructure, ensuring high performance and stability
  • Design and implement efficient, scalable, and resilient trading solutions
  • Troubleshoot and enhance exchange connectivity and execution speed
  • Support functional and component testing for critical trading components
What We're Looking For
Technical Skills & Experience
  • Strong experience in Rust and/or C++ (C background also considered)
  • Prior experience in a trading environment (HFT, Market Making, Prop Trading, or similar)
  • Eagerness to become an expert in Rust (if not already)
  • Experience with PostgreSQL databases and protobuf-based protocols or similar.
  • Exchange connectivity experience and/or FPGA technologies (strongly preferred)
  • Experience in High-Frequency Options Trading and low-latency systems (nice to have)
Soft Skills & Competencies
  • Ownership & Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Write high-quality, maintainable code, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
  • Initiative & Problem-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
  • Curiosity & Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
  • Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.
  • Knowledge of latency optimization through Speculative Execution Rollback (SER) is highly valued.
Our recruitment philosophy
We value self-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A technology enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

  • Head of Engineering interview (technical)
  • Rust challenge
  • Head of BU interview
  • Meet the team chat
  • Offer
Our offer
  • Competitive salary package
  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

title: Senior Staff Software Test Engineer
description:
Senior Staff Software Test Engineer

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS , one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times/ week or 8 days/ month) or Porto Alegre (3 times/ week or 12 days/ month). Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital is hiring for empathetic, curious software test engineers to join our growing team. We work in a dynamic and fulfilling atmosphere and help our clients’ build robust mobile and web applications. Our Test Engineering technologies vary by project, so we value flexibility and willingness to learn. Our goal is to build amazing solutions for our clients, and ensuring a quality experience is a crucial part of how we deliver on that promise.

Responsibilities

  • Confidently deliver high-quality test strategies and implementation, applying critical thinking to products, requirements, and processes.
  • Definite test strategies according to each client and business needs.
  • Create and write test plans, defining how tests will be structured and communicated.
  • Work closely with clients
  • Have professional test engineering experience— we’re thinking at least 5 years
  • Apply various types of testing methodologies and work collaboratively on implementation
  • Help mentor and coach a project team towards shared goals and outcomes
  • Navigate difficult conversations by providing constructive feedback to teams and clients
  • You’ll identify obstacles to ensure quality, improve our user experience and how we build tests
  • Self-aware of limitations, yet curious to learn new solutions while being receptive to constructive feedback from teammates
  • You’ll guide your team to understand and work through changing priorities by bringing positive energy
  • Communicate and simplify complex problems in order to foster understanding across multidisciplinary teams
  • Apply your knowledge and findings at an organizational scale

Qualifications

  • + 7 years of experience with testing methodologies and implementation
  • Relevant communication of testing approach and decisions to clients and teammates
  • Professional programming experience
  • Experience architecting robust automated testing suites across different platforms
  • Experience using Cypress.io, TestCafe, Selenium, native mobile test frameworks for iOS or Android.
  • Advocate of SDLC processes
  • Embody a growth mindset and are committed to continuously learning new technologies and honing your craft
  • Experience recommending test solutions for a particular platform's problem
  • Inspire others to write code that is durable, secure, scalable, always up and running
  • Have experience sharing knowledge with teammates through mentorship, code reviews, and pair programming sessions
  • Have strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
  • Have worked with relational and/or NoSQL databases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing for accessibility with tools such as screen readers and an appreciation for inclusive and accessible UI implementations
  • Experience writing and executing tests for SEO, or Analytics
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g. Jenkins, CircleCI, Fastlane) and experience setting up deployment pipelines
  • Some experience with load, performance, penetration, or security testing
  • Engagement in thought leadership (Blog articles, Git Gists, Stack Overflow answers)
  • Familiarity with one CMS: EpiServer; Sitefinity; AEM

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

In addition to being part of an international and innovative consultancy company, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international consultancy at the forefront of technology
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Playground: Dive into the latest technologies and shape the future of digital solutions
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with world-renowned brands, making a real impact in the market
  • Growth-Centric Environment: Thrive in our collaborative ecosystem with a clear career development path
  • Global Exposure: Embrace optional international travel opportunities to broaden your horizons

Some of our benefits:

  • Health and dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Senior Staff Software Test Engineer
description:
Senior Staff Software Test Engineer

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS , one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times/ week or 8 days/ month) or Porto Alegre (3 times/ week or 12 days/ month). Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital is hiring for empathetic, curious software test engineers to join our growing team. We work in a dynamic and fulfilling atmosphere and help our clients’ build robust mobile and web applications. Our Test Engineering technologies vary by project, so we value flexibility and willingness to learn. Our goal is to build amazing solutions for our clients, and ensuring a quality experience is a crucial part of how we deliver on that promise.

Responsibilities

  • Confidently deliver high-quality test strategies and implementation, applying critical thinking to products, requirements, and processes.
  • Definite test strategies according to each client and business needs.
  • Create and write test plans, defining how tests will be structured and communicated.
  • Work closely with clients
  • Have professional test engineering experience— we’re thinking at least 5 years
  • Apply various types of testing methodologies and work collaboratively on implementation
  • Help mentor and coach a project team towards shared goals and outcomes
  • Navigate difficult conversations by providing constructive feedback to teams and clients
  • You’ll identify obstacles to ensure quality, improve our user experience and how we build tests
  • Self-aware of limitations, yet curious to learn new solutions while being receptive to constructive feedback from teammates
  • You’ll guide your team to understand and work through changing priorities by bringing positive energy
  • Communicate and simplify complex problems in order to foster understanding across multidisciplinary teams
  • Apply your knowledge and findings at an organizational scale

Qualifications

  • + 7 years of experience with testing methodologies and implementation
  • Relevant communication of testing approach and decisions to clients and teammates
  • Professional programming experience
  • Experience architecting robust automated testing suites across different platforms
  • Experience using Cypress.io, TestCafe, Selenium, native mobile test frameworks for iOS or Android.
  • Advocate of SDLC processes
  • Embody a growth mindset and are committed to continuously learning new technologies and honing your craft
  • Experience recommending test solutions for a particular platform's problem
  • Inspire others to write code that is durable, secure, scalable, always up and running
  • Have experience sharing knowledge with teammates through mentorship, code reviews, and pair programming sessions
  • Have strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
  • Have worked with relational and/or NoSQL databases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing for accessibility with tools such as screen readers and an appreciation for inclusive and accessible UI implementations
  • Experience writing and executing tests for SEO, or Analytics
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g. Jenkins, CircleCI, Fastlane) and experience setting up deployment pipelines
  • Some experience with load, performance, penetration, or security testing
  • Engagement in thought leadership (Blog articles, Git Gists, Stack Overflow answers)
  • Familiarity with one CMS: EpiServer; Sitefinity; AEM

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

In addition to being part of an international and innovative consultancy company, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international consultancy at the forefront of technology
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Playground: Dive into the latest technologies and shape the future of digital solutions
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with world-renowned brands, making a real impact in the market
  • Growth-Centric Environment: Thrive in our collaborative ecosystem with a clear career development path
  • Global Exposure: Embrace optional international travel opportunities to broaden your horizons

Some of our benefits:

  • Health and dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy .

description:
O Gerente Comercial é o profissional que atua dentro da empresa, atendendo o cliente, negociando interesses e coordenando o time responsável pela realização de um serviço. Ele será o responsável por organizar os recursos humanos e materiais disponíveis, alocando-os de acordo às necessidades, além de elaborar um cronograma de ações e disponibilizá-lo para todos os envolvidos no serviço.
Gestão de pessoas, processos, budget, prazos, produtos e insumos.
Missão do cargo:
Gerenciamento da unidade, time, resultados, organização e bom funcionamento.
Principais responsabilidades:
Gestão, treinamento, capacitação e desenvolvimento do time. Parcerias para ações dentro e fora da unidade. Entrega das metas da unidade, assim como manter o funcionamento da unidade e de todos os seus processos dentro dos padrões exigidos pela franqueadora, conforme manuais e compliance.
Principais competências:
Liderança, comunicação, persuação, proatividade, dinamismo, negociação, organização, planejamento, influência, visão estratégica, visão de mercado, ética, foco no cliente, expertise para vendas presencial e online.
Atividades:

  • Treina e desenvolve o time com as normas de atendimento padrões da empresa, garantindo e planejando um atendimento de excelência para os clientes;
  • Treina e desenvolve o time para alcance das metas da unidades;
  • Responsável pela gestão de pessoas e resultados da unidade;
  • Responsável por montar escalas mensais do time;
  • Gerencia e direciona atividades do time;
  • Atua na implantação e correção de procedimentos padrões;
  • Realiza avaliação de novos clientes;
  • Executa vendas e revendas dos pacotes de depilação a laser;
  • Presta atendimento e esclarece dúvidas de clientes;
  • Faz tratativa com cliente afim de evitar cancelamento de contrato;
  • Realiza desligamento de colaboradoras;
  • Fornece feedbacks e faz follow-up, visando corrigir comportamentos dos colaboradores dentro do ambiente de trabalho, além de melhorias em cada setor.
  • Extrai relatórios do sistema;
  • Responsável pelo bom funcionamento e manutenção e higiene da unidade;
  • Co-responsável pelo acompanhamento de todas as intercorrências e resultados desfavoráveis, prestando assistência e esclarecimentos ao cliente;
  • Desenvolve estudos sobre o potencial de vendas da região, realiza parcerias e prospecção de clientes para ações internas (unidade) e externas (rua), visando a ampliação do volume de negócios;

  • Reporta necessidade de manutenção na unidade;
  • Reporta informações sobre equipe e resultados para gerente de apoio/franqueado;
  • Monitora toda a documentação exigida pelos órgãos fiscalizadores e reportar para o escritório.
Esse cargo não é pra você:
Se você não possui afinidade com a gestão de equipes de vendas, desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais, alcance de metas desafiadoras ou não segue o direcionamento aplicado por sua gestora, este cargo pode não ser o ideal.
A posição de Gerente Comercial requer uma liderança proativa, seguir diretrizes pré estabelecidas, habilidade em elaborar e implementar estratégias de vendas eficazes, além de habilidade para analisar resultados e ajustá-los conforme necessário.
Nosso objetivo é encontrar alguém que seja apaixonado por impulsionar resultados e liderar equipes rumo ao sucesso. Se a ideia de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e voltado para resultados não o entusiasma, esta posição pode não ser adequada para você.

RAPP has a tradition that encourages entrepreneurial thinking, innovative solutions, and the conviction to executive. We seek individuals who thrive in fast-paced, problem-solving environments. We’re looking for a talented Front-end Developer with a specialtyin Email to join our team of marketing technology pros. These solutions include everything from emails, display, landing pages, complex analytics dashboards and mobile applications.

The ideal developer should have experience using digital marketing platforms like Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

  • Develop & modify responsive email templates, display ads, landing pages & microsites.

  • 3-5 years programming experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in CS or related preferred, not required
  • 1+ years email-specific development experience
  • Experience with any JS frameworks is a plus.
  • Fluent with GIT version control and associated branching models.
  • Experience with a template engine (Razor, GTL, Twig) is a plus
  • Experience working with Content Management Systems
  • Experience with QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid
  • Experience with Email Service Providers (ESPs) such Salesforce Marketing Cloud/ExactTarget, Campaign Monitor, MailChimp), with advanced capabilities using the ESP scripting language (Ampscript, GTL, Server-side JS)
  • Photoshop proficiency required to manipulate assets.
  • Experience with Figma is a plus.
  • General understanding of layout and user interface design is nice to have
  • Detail oriented, organized, and the ability to meet deadlines while working several projects simultaneously
  • Self-motivated, a natural problem-solver, and a good communicator with a demonstrated ability to oversee multiple projects simultaneously and work collaboratively in a team environment

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

Roughly $6T is laundered every year and $180B is spent on anti-money-laundering efforts by US institutions. Despite this, less than 1% of laundered money is identified correctly. We are also seeing many systems produce false-positive rates of over 95%. Consequently, banks and the government must spend extra time and resources on extraneous investigations, taking away resources from finding criminals.
Product
To achieve our goal, we ingest and standardize millions of messy data points coming from financial institutions that may sign up for the service. Once we have standardized and ingested the data, we can run complex calculations on it, checking for suspicious behavior and building a score around the riskiness of a given profile. If anything is found, we can surface that to our clients. By providing information accessibility, building intuitive workflows, allowing for custom processing, and curating accurate data, we can reduce the false-positive rate of our calculations, and reduce the amount of work dedicated to a given investigation.
You
We are looking for engineers who are excited about building a company from the ground up. As a founding engineer at Sandbar, you'll be responsible for defining and building features in our product to enable our customers to model and detect suspicious activity on their platforms. You'll work cross-functionally, collaborating with members of the team who have expertise in the subject matter, product management, design, infrastructure and security, to solve real-world problems our customers face. You'll have a lot of autonomy and freedom. You will learn and touch almost every part of the stack; big bonus if you're comfortable being a "Swiss Army knife". As we grow, you will be able to determine your own path and build skills you want to develop by directing your career growth and specialization. You're excited by and personally interested in how AI is reshaping they way we build products and solve problems; and you want to use it for positive far-reaching, real-world impact.
Team
We’re a small, but mighty and collaborative team based in NYC focused on delivering world-class software for our clients. You will not be in NYC, but you will visit NYC every now and then. And multiple people from our NYC office will visit you more often; in-person collaboration is priceless in the early days of building an enduring business so we will do our best to continue that value with our Central and South American teammates. We've raised from some amazing investors and have a group of amazing advisors and partners who can help us build the right things. This includes 3 institutional VC funds––Lachy Groom, Abstract Ventures, and BoxGroup––and 45+ angel investors including founders, executives, and early employees of Ramp, Stripe, Plaid, Remitly, Revolut, Google, Open AI, Square, and more.
What You'll Do

  • Work with a broad range of technologies and systems to own and solve problems end-to-end.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, and product managers to build new features in our product and data platform.
  • Contribute to our technical vision and uphold our high engineering standards.
  • Leverage new technologies like AI to continuously uplevel the quality and speed of delivery.
What You'll Need
  • 5 years of relevant work experience.
  • Great communication skills, and a high degree of awareness and agency.
  • Track record of delivering high-quality products and features end-to-end.
  • Ability to turn real-world problems and opportunities into engineering solutions.
  • Desire to work in a highly collaborative environment, and to continuously grow and master your craft.
  • Experience or willingness to heavily leverage new technologies like AI in your code and the product itself.
Nice-to-haves
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Pulumi, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of SQL and experience with Postgres.
  • Experience with Flink, Iceberg, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working in a large Java codebase.

About Us

GSCF | | Rio de Janeiro – Brazil

GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring, and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets, and eliminate risk.

Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise, and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships, and strategic guidance.

Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.

GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.

The Client Success Operations Team is responsible for the diligent management of the assigned Buyers including country specifics, client servicing, service delivery, exceptions processing, program monitoring and risks reporting.

  • Ensure agreements and all programs relevant procedures are updated regularly and safely stored on its respective file cabinets.

  • Support additional ad-hoc projects.

  • Contribute to maintaining a positive, transparent, open and creative thinking working environment.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Fluent in English and Spanish.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.


What you'll do

Viasat seeks an expert attorney to provide legal support for Viasat's business units via the in-house legal department in São Paulo, Brazil. This role will also involve collaboration with the business and legal teams from the United States, other Latin American countries, and Europe. We provide strategic support for satellite telecommunications operations. We ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, draft and review contracts, handle risk, and support business initiatives related to satellite communications, spectrum management, and international regulations.

By joining our legal team, you will gain hands-on experience in satellite telecommunications law, regulatory compliance, and contract negotiations. You will have the opportunity to work on real cases involving spectrum allocation, international agreements, and industry regulations. You'll also engage with various customers, including regulatory agencies, external legal firms, and business units, gaining exposure to the complexities of the satellite industry.


The day-to-day
  • Provide advice to all levels of Viasat in the areas of telecommunications transactions, regulation, administrative and litigation matters, and communicate legal concepts in a way that non-lawyers can understand.
  • Legal Research & Analysis: Conducting research on laws related to contracts, regulatory, corporate and taxes matters
  • Contract Review & Drafting: Assisting in the preparation and review of complex contracts, partnership and service agreements, NDAs, and compliance documents.
  • Regulatory Compliance Support: Monitoring changes in laws and preparing summaries or reports for the legal team;
  • Risk Assessment: Identifying potential legal risks in business operations and helping develop mitigation strategies.
  • Litigation: Lead litigation at all levels and supervise outside litigation counsel.
  • Meetings & Teamwork: Participating in meetings with commercial teams, engineers, specialists, and external legal counsels to support business objectives.

What you'll need
  • Law degree from a recognized and respected law school and admission to the Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB).
  • Ability to speak and write (including contract drafting and editing) English at a professional level.
  • At least 7 years of legal experience with a respected law firm or company in the following areas (preferably in the telecommunications industry, but will consider experience in other regulated industries):
    • Commercial contracts (drafting, reviewing, and negotiation)
    • Corporate law (corporate formation, governance and maintenance)
    • Tax law (knowledge of tax planning and indirect taxes applicable to telecommunications services is a plus)
    • Litigation (external law firm management, preparation and review of strategic pleadings)
    • Consumer law (handling administrative and judicial claims)
    • Regulatory law (experience with ANATEL or regulated technology sectors is preferred)
  • Microsoft Office Proficiency – Experience using Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to conduct legal research using national and international sources.
  • Ability to assess legal risks, interpret regulations, and apply critical thinking to real-world cases.
  • Strong Written and Verbal Communication – Ability to clearly articulate legal concepts and draft well-structured documents.
  • Proactive Approach – Ability to take initiative, handle multiple tasks, and ensure accuracy in legal documents.
  • Ability to work at least 3 days per week in person at the Viasat office in São Paulo during business hours.

What will help you on the job
  • An interest in innovation, technology, and regulatory issues, especially in the telecommunication's area.
  • Spanish language ability.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management software.
  • Familiarity with additional areas of law such as labor and privacy.
  • Post graduate degree in public, regulatory, privacy, or intellectual property law.

· The role has a global remit but will focus on key markets and treatment venues. It will require the setting up and maintenance of strong networks, internally and externally, focused on current and future clinical practice.

New Product Development (NPD) Core Teams.

· • Clinical case compendiums for LATAM

· Lead the creation and delivery of educational materials and training programs for medical, sales, and marketing teams.

· Accountable for the evidence generation strategy planning and execution, incl. clinical studies, Investigator Initiated Studies (IIS), RWD and others for both pipeline and in market products as appropriate for LATAM.

E) Cross-functional Collaboration:

· Collaborate with the Clinical Research Team/s to ensure proper conduct of LATAM based clinical trials

· Collaborate with the regulatory affairs team to ensure timely approvals and market access for wound care products.

A degree in nursing – Wound and Ostomy Care is preferred. Candidates having a MD / PhD in life sciences degree may be considered. Strong command in Spanish, Portuguese and proficiency in English (speaking and written) is desirable

· Previous experience in the medical device, biotechnology, and tissue biologics of the healthcare industry.

· Comprehensive knowledge of the Wound, Ostomy and/ or Continence care therapeutic landscape, with a strong understanding of Latin American medical landscape is highly desirable.

· Strong understanding of regulatory requirements, clinical trial design, and evidence generation in LATAM

· Expertise in scientific communication, including publications, conference presentations, and medical education.

· Exceptional quantitative, analytical, and written skills.

· Excellent negotiation skills for a wide variety of audiences, including sales and marketing leadership.

description:
Senior Staff BCO - 1st Line Compliance Lead

About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our institutional page

About the Team

As Nubank continues its global expansion and continues innovating, the internal controls landscape becomes increasingly complex. Nubank has developed a strong Risk structure across the 1st and 2nd line of Defense but it is important to continue reinforcing the principles across the company and ensure that our 1st line teams continue to be accountable and responsible for the risks taken.

On that basis, the Business Control Office team is continuing to grow by adding one more area of focus and hiring someone to help us elevate our compliance management within the 1st line of Defense .

About the Role

Regulatory compliance is a complex and a critical component of proper risk management which requires very specific expertise. The initial person joining as the head of 1st line Compliance would help us drive the regulatory agenda in the 1st line with clear accountability and responsibility, and start supporting prioritized teams who are facing regulatory challenges.

It´s an IC position in the beginning with a global scope, with the opportunity to become a manager if the person has the ability to demonstrate how a team could help Nubank become more efficient and compliant with an increased level of support.

Key Responsabilities and Expectations

  • Understanding applicable regulations, and explaining/translating the need to the business according to the BU realities
    • Reading regulations and understanding their implications for the business, making sure requirements are fully mapped through the existing regulatory tracking process
    • Provide assessment to the 1st line through the discovery of regulatory requirements
    • Help the 1LoD to co-create and finalize e2e action plans to be compliant with applicable regulatory requirements, supporting Compliance 2LoD in the monitoring of the implementation of the requirements for new products/features and other regulatory requirements (e.g. 4966)
    • Aligning possible dependencies with other BUs and helping with prioritizations exercise of different bets.
  • Coordinate and support on responses and data shared with regulators (BACEN, CVM, Banxico, SFC, etc) and external/internal auditors on relevant subjects, for both reactive and proactive interactions.
  • Support Compliance on the planning and coordination of inspection when they happen
  • Empowering product teams with the knowledge and tools they need making compliance a competitive advantage of the innovation process making it seamless under a targeted friction approach
  • Performing regulatory assessment proactively for NP&F including the creation and follow up of action plans ahead of Defense assessments
  • Create appropriate timely reports for the leadership team to understand the full spectrum of regulatory risks

What we're looking for:

  • Technical experience: Compliance
  • Ability to challenge the various Lines of Defense
  • Strong ability to prioritise
  • Ability to build strong relationships with all levels of the organization
  • Great communication skills (concise and clear)
  • Hands on and take ownership where possible
  • High level of independence/autonomy
  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check more information here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

title: Coordenador (a) Programa Bilíngue
description:
O programa bilíngue do Colégio SEPP é uma proposta inovadora que visa proporcionar uma educação de excelência, integrando o aprendizado de línguas com o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos. Com uma abordagem pedagógica que valoriza a imersão em um segundo idioma, o programa oferece um currículo diversificado, onde os alunos têm a oportunidade de aprender conteúdos de diferentes disciplinas.

A função do coordenador do programa bilíngue no Colégio SEPP envolve diversas responsabilidades, incluindo:

  1. Planejamento Curricular : Desenvolver e implementar um currículo bilíngue que atenda às diretrizes educacionais, integrando conteúdos em português e em outro idioma (geralmente inglês).

  2. Formação de Professores : Organizar capacitações e treinamentos para a equipe docente, garantindo que os professores estejam preparados para ensinar em um ambiente bilíngue.

  3. Avaliação e Monitoramento : Avaliar o progresso dos alunos, monitorar o desempenho acadêmico e propor estratégias de melhoria.

  4. Interação com as famílias : Manter comunicação com pais e responsáveis, promovendo atividades e eventos que expliquem a proposta do programa bilíngue.

  5. Apoio Pedagógico : Oferecer suporte a professores e alunos, auxiliando na resolução de dificuldades e promovendo um ambiente de aprendizagem inclusivo.

  6. Gestão Administrativa : Supervisionar a parte administrativa do programa, incluindo a organização de materiais didáticos e recursos necessários.

Competências Necessárias:

  1. Liderança : Capacidade de inspirar e motivar a equipe docente, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo.
  2. Conhecimento Pedagógico : Domínio das teorias e práticas educacionais, além de estar atualizado com as tendências de ensino.
  3. Comunicação : Habilidade para se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com professores, alunos e pais, facilitando o diálogo e a resolução de conflitos.
  4. Organização : Capacidade de planejar, coordenar e gerenciar atividades pedagógicas e administrativas de forma eficiente.

description:
Why Valtech? We’re advisors, visionaries, creative and techies. We embrace all things digital. We talk to each other. We have fun. We love our clients. We’re looking ahead • We are global

Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values -driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

As a Strategy Consultant Sr , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 5 years of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

  • Collaborate with commercial and technical teams on global client projects, focusing on strategy and performance across CRM & Marketing Automation, Inbound Marketing, Content Marketing, and related areas;
  • Research benchmarks, lead brainstorming sessions, and define concepts and storytelling for use cases (campaigns, journeys, and website experiences);
  • Design use case strategies in Miro, including flows and detailed documentation such as main objectives and audience segmentation;
  • Write complete creative briefs and support in reviewing final deliverables to ensure alignment with the proposed strategy;
  • Analyze results and create reports, identifying insights and proposing strategy optimizations, A/B testing, and guiding next project steps;
  • Lead discovery, consulting, and brainstorming sessions with clients to understand their short-, mid-, and long-term business goals, user behavior and lifecycle, and more. Support in creating, planning, and prioritizing the roadmap;
  • Support clients and development teams during implementation and QA processes to ensure final delivery meets strategic and performance expectations;
  • Assist the team lead and project management teams in creating and updating workflows, effort estimates, documentation and briefing templates, presentations, sales proposals, and other related materials.

Must have qualifications

  • Experience in marketing, planning, and/or strategy projects;
  • Experience in CRM Marketing projects (automation and/or one-off sends);
  • Knowledge of or hands-on experience with marketing automation tools such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Marketo, RD Station, HubSpot, or similar;
  • Experience with CRM channel strategies (email, SMS, push notifications, and/or WhatsApp);
  • Tech-savvy and eager to learn more about Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC);
  • Strong business and marketing acumen. Good listening skills, with the ability to identify client pain points and real needs, and propose concrete strategic solutions;
  • Intermediate proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel);
  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, Design, or related fields — or a degree in another area with relevant marketing experience;
  • Advanced English;
  • Availability to occasionally work on-site at the office.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Intermediate to advanced Spanish proficiency;
  • Experience monitoring and analyzing data from Google Analytics, Datorama dashboards, Power BI, or Data Studio, and creating slide decks for reporting presentations;
  • Knowledge of and/or experience in other digital marketing areas and channels (e.g., content, social media, paid media, websites, blogs, digital products, etc.);
  • Knowledge of and/or hands-on experience setting up and implementing CRM or Inbound Marketing campaigns, basic HTML, SQL, or other technical steps in the automation process;
  • Experience working on digital projects for large companies involving agencies or consultancies (either as part of the agency team or the client-side team).

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a CLT/PJ position based in Brazil- SP .

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.
The role entails

  • Leading your team in optimising and expanding the Ubuntu gaming experience, focusing on the Steam Snap.
  • Managing project timelines, balancing feature improvements with deadlines.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to align your team's work with other teams and company objectives.
  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.
  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.
What we are looking for in you
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.
  • Initiative in proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.
  • Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.
  • A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

Job description

Se você sempre sonhou em trabalhar em uma das empresas que mais emprega no Brasil, que está em constante transformação e investe em projetos de inovação, essa é sua chance!

Realizar lançamentos de cabos metálicos em postes ou dutos, em espaços confinados e rede aérea, auxiliando os cabistas e lideres nas instalações de armários de distribuição, caixas de emendas aéreas ou subterrâneas, espinhar cabos aéreos, retirada rede de cabos e fios e na execução de manutenção preventiva e corretiva e de proteção elétrica (proteção de cabos telefônicos) em toda a rede de acesso de telecomunicações, atendendo os indicadores operacionais definidos pelo cliente contratante e/ou pela companhia.

Se interessou? Venha trabalhar em uma empresa que conecta pessoas!

  • Controlar o estoque de materiais de redes utilizados pela equipe, verificando as quantidades existentes, solicitando reposição, objetivando o bom andamento dos serviços;
  • Preparar os cabos no interior das câmaras subterrâneas e/ou rede aérea, efetuando curvatura e dimensionamento para as aberturas, a fim de adequá-los conforme as normas de padronização para a execução de emendas;
  • Auxiliar no trabalho implantação e retirada de postes, realizando escavações com auxilio de ferramentas apropriadas, visando a retirada ou instalação de rede aérea;

  • Dirigir veiculo da empresa, transportando pessoas e/ou materiais, sempre que necessário e quando for definido pela empresa, visando a consecução das atividades afetadas da sua área de atuação;
  • Cumprir todas as normas e procedimentos constantes das orientações relativas a saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho, reportando os desvios ao superior imediato; realizar atividades em proximidades a rede elétrica e em espaços confinados.

title: Supervisor Operações CS / Atendimento
description:
Na Onisys by nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia.

Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos Pilares Culturais e Seus Atributos São:

  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética;
  • Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo;
  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados.

Somos nstech, a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo e estamos construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é impactar a sociedade de forma positiva, reduzindo a poluição, o trânsito, as mortes nas estradas e os custos logísticos. Além disso, impulsionamos o crescimento econômico, a equidade salarial, a diversidade e o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional.

Pensamos grande e temos um sonho ousado: melhorar o mundo através da tecnologia para logística e mobilidade. Já estamos presentes em 11 países - Brasil, EUA, México, Colômbia, Peru, Equador, Bolívia, Chile, Argentina, Portugal, Angola - e continuamos expandindo nosso impacto pelo mundo.

Responsabilidades do Supervisor de Operações (Suporte e CS)

  • Gestão da equipe de suporte e CS: Supervisionar times de atendimento e sucesso do cliente, garantindo que as demandas sejam atendidas com agilidade, qualidade e foco na experiência do cliente.
  • Acompanhamento de SLAs e KPIs: Assegurar o cumprimento dos acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs), além de monitorar e analisar indicadores como tempo médio de atendimento, taxa de resolução no primeiro contato, NPS, CSAT e churn.
  • Planejamento operacional: Organizar escalas, distribuir tarefas e priorizar chamados, garantindo o balanceamento da carga de trabalho e a cobertura em horários críticos.

title: Multinacional recruta 30 pessoas com deficiência em Hortolândia
description:
Ação contou com apoio da Prefeitura e da ONG Pernas Voluntárias
Promover a inclusão por meio da força do trabalho. Com esse objetivo, a Prefeitura de Hortolândia, por meio de parceria com a ONG (Organização Não Governamental) Pernas Voluntárias e a Premiere Soluções em Recursos Humanos, promoveu nesta sexta-feira, 23 de setembro, uma seleção de empregos para a empresa multinacional Ceva Logística. A meta da empresa é contratar 30 pessoas com deficiência, moradores de Hortolândia.

De acordo com a gerente de Recursos Humanos da Ceva Logística, Alice Almeida, as vagas preencherão diversos setores da empresa. Hoje a empresa conta com cerca de 800 colaboradores. “A Ceva tem a sua sede na cidade de Campinas e por meio de um contato com o Departamento de Direitos Humanos resolvemos estreitar relacionamento e realizar esse processo de seleção. Buscamos pessoas com deficiência para compor nosso quadro de trabalhadores, pois achamos importante garantir essa inclusão e, podem ter certeza, esse é o início de uma parceria com a Prefeitura de Hortolândia, que será estendida”, comentou Alice.

Além do processo de seleção para contratação imediata de 30 pessoas com deficiência, a Premiere Soluções em Recursos Humanos fará um banco de dados para encaminhamento de pessoas com deficiência para o mercado de trabalho.

De acordo com a chefe de Setor de Políticas Públicas para Deficientes, Cristiane Rocha, o processo de seleção teve uma procura grande e destacou a realização do trabalho em busca de garantir inclusão social e cidadania por meio do trabalho. “Com apoio do nosso prefeito José Nazareno Zezé Gomes e da ONG Pernas Voluntárias, da qual sou presidente, conseguimos realizar esse importante processo de seleção. A legislação brasileira prevê que as organizações empregadoras, em especial as empresas privadas, possuem responsabilidades quanto à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência em seu quadro de colaboradores e o nosso grande objetivo é divulgar, fortalecer e conscientizar essa prática que é muito importante”, comentou Cristiane.

A Lei Federal n° 8.213 de 1991 estabelece que empresas com cem ou mais empregados devem preencher uma parte dos seus cargos com pessoas com deficiência. “Se uma organização tem entre 100 e 200 colaboradores, 2% devem ser pessoas com deficiência. De 201 a 500 colaboradores, a porcentagem sobe para 3%. Em uma empresa com 501 a 1.000 funcionários, deve existir 4% de PCD e, acima de 1.000 colaboradores, a cota a ser respeitada sobe para 5%. Esse é o grande desafio e acredito que atividades como essa possam contribuir muito no encaminhamento de pessoas com deficiência ao mercado de trabalho”, finalizou Cristiane.
